sentences.text: Andhra Pradesh -LRB- -LSB- , ahndr@_pr@'dEsh -RSB- -RRB- is one of the 29 states of India , situated on the southeastern coast of the country .	states of India	States and territories of India	India	India
The state is the eighth largest state in India covering an area of 162307 km2 .	eighth	List of states and territories of India by area	India	India

As per 2011 Census of India , the state is tenth largest by population with 49,386,799 inhabitants .	India	India	2011 Census of India	2011 Census of India	tenth	List of states and union territories of India by population
On 2 June 2014 , the north-western portion of the state was bifurcated to form a new state of Telangana .	Telangana	Telangana
Andhra Pradesh 's longtime capital , Hyderabad , was transferred to Telangana as part of the division .	Telangana	Telangana	Hyderabad	Hyderabad

However , in accordance with the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act , 2014 , Hyderabad will remain the de jure capital of both Andhra Pradesh and Telangana states for a period of time not exceeding 10 years .	Telangana	Telangana	Hyderabad	Hyderabad	de jure	de jure

The Gross State Domestic Product -LRB- GSDP -RRB- of the state in the 2016 -- 2017 financial year at current prices stood at .	State	States of India	Gross State Domestic Product	List of Indian states and union territories by GDP

The state has a coastline of 974 km with jurisdiction over nearly 15,000 km2 territorial waters , the second longest among all the states of India after Gujarat .	states of India	States and territories of India	India	India	coastline	coastline	Gujarat	Gujarat

It is bordered by Telangana in the north-west , Chhattisgarh in the north , Odisha in the north-east , Karnataka in the west , Tamil Nadu in the south and the water body of Bay of Bengal in the east . Andhra Pradesh is composed of two regions : Coastal Andhra , located along the Bay of Bengal , and Rayalaseema , in the inland southwestern part of the state .	Bay of Bengal	Bay of Bengal	Coastal Andhra	Coastal Andhra	Rayalaseema	Rayalaseema

Visakhapatnam , located on the Bay of Bengal in North Coastal Andhra is the largest city and commercial hub of the state with a GDP of $ 26 billion , followed in population and GDP by Vijayawada , which is located on the Krishna River and which has a GDP of $ 3 billion as of 2010 . Andhra Pradesh hosted 121.8 million visitors in 2015 , a 30 % growth in tourist arrivals over the previous year .
